inputs.text: Organisers of the “No Kings” protests said an estimated 8 million people attended more than 3,300 events across all 50 US states, showing opposition to President Donald Trump’s leadership. AFP reported that the events took place nationwide, although US authorities have not provided an official count. Organisers said turnout was higher than at the previous No Kings demonstrations in October, with “about one million more participants and 600 more events.”
